scripts.deploycf: node -e "console.error('Direct deploy is disabled — production deploys go ONLY through the gated Deploy (production) GitHub Action: merge to main, green CI, manual approval. See docs/runbooks/deploy.md'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.deploy:ci: pnpm init:config && node pre-deploy.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: pnpm init:config && wrangler types && pnpm prettier --write . && pnpm migrate && wrangler dev --port 8080
scripts.migrate:remote: drizzle-kit generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply one-balance --remote
scripts.migrate: drizzle-kit generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply one-balance --local
